Attentive Service but a Dining Experience That Falls Short of Expectations
Aug 2026 • Couples
I recently went to Matsuri Nguyễn Huệ for dinner, and the experience was good but nothing outstanding. There were many positive points but a few blips along the way.

Food
Most of the dishes were acceptable. Nothing stood out, though most dishes were done well enough.
Their special yuzu beef dish has a pleasant yuzu sauce flavor. However, the sauce was too watery, so it could not coat the beef well and made for a less satisfying taste.
It would also be good to get the kitchen to serve food more quickly. We were a large group and expected to be served more quickly than we were.

Service
The service staff were as you would expect at a high-quality restaurant: very attentive, always courteous, and took great care to ensure all our requirements were met.

Overall Impression
A decent experience all round. Although Matsuri Nguyễn Huệ delivered a satisfactory experience, the long wait for the dishes was extremely disappointing and, let us face it, some parts of the food could have been better executed; for example, the yuzu sauce was too thin to coat the beef.

Overall, the dinner was good enough to make me want to go back to other restaurants in the area.

Premier food was provided by Miyen - Japanese Fusion Cuisine
Oct 2023 • Family
Good services: (i) when our family dropped in front of the Miyen - Japanese Fusion Cuisine, a man came immediately to assist us to drive the car into the parking area. I felt comfortable with this service of the restaurant, totally different with other restaurants, because they usually do not have enough space for parking cars; (ii) passed the entrance, two women wearing kimono and greeting customers in Japanese language, behind entrance it appeals to eyes of customer with three areas, cooking demonstration, drinks bar, and area to play Japanese songs; (iii) we were guided by a waiter to move to a circle table in the center of the restaurant, the waiter always kept smile and provided us a menu with detailed recommendations. We were taken care of by a waitress during our time there.
 
Regarding meals: (i) Miyen - Japanese Fusion Cuisine launched by a Japanese person; (ii) meals at Miyen's highest level, especially sushi and sashimi must be made by fish and fresh vegetables. According to a waitress, all of the materials were chosen and bought by a chef (iii) My company has cooperated with some partners in Japan, and I have many business trips to Tokyo and tried local food there. With Matsuri, I do not see the difference when I compared it with the restaurant in Tokyo; (iv) Miyen - Japanese Fusion Cuisine provided premier food and showed art-food to my family.
